assembly_scope_limitations: Current original final pages and overview are unchanged copies of the draft, even when review.page assessments explain corrections.
No module_source body was requested by the model; source was verified/catalogued but installer/locator review remains unperformed.
All registered paths are structurally covered; unregistered host UI, resource table entries and runtime/server variants remain outside complete-coverage claims.

bounded_source_prefetch_design.selection_scope: One reviewed explicit candidate per page plus two common contracts; this samples installer/locator coverage, not every feature.
bounded_source_prefetch_design.excerpt_policy: Exact pinned context only; bounded line windows around approved declaration/install/lookup anchors; never silently use latest working tree; missing anchors record unavailable; explicit lines/truncated/sha256/selection version; no filename-only coverage inference.
bounded_source_prefetch_design.privacy: Private excerpts travel only in model context; public journal records exact path/SHA/ranges/truncation, never source bodies.
bounded_source_prefetch_design.binding: Bind deterministic selection manifest digest and excerpt policy into fresh-run input identity; actual request hash includes excerpts.
bounded_source_prefetch_design.model_requests: No added POST solely for prefetch; evidence available in existing draft and independent review calls. Token/time impact must be measured, not declared free.
bounded_source_prefetch_design.legacy_recovery: No injection into legacy bound runs. Missing prefetch descriptor uses legacy behavior; preserve all IDs, prefixes, counters and original_review_start. New mode needs version-aware initial-prefix and replay checks before release.
bounded_source_prefetch_design.replay_hazard: Current _rebuild treats non-page reads as model tools and assumes initial journal contains page reads only. Deterministic module_source rows require an authenticated server-prefetch manifest and server_read replay; otherwise they would incorrectly spend the six model slots or fail prefix checks. Do not change legacy interpretation implicitly.
